name: Jewish Quarter and St Procopius' Basilica in Třebíč
description: In the Czech town of Třebíč, a tangle of narrow lanes and tightly packed houses marks one of Europe's best-preserved Jewish quarters, with its old cemetery nearby. Just across the river rises St Procopius' Basilica, a early 13th-century church built for a Benedictine monastery in a Western European style. Together they show Jewish and Christian communities living side by side for centuries.
